title: Bitget Customers Withdraw Over 4,000 Bitcoins in One Hour Following $388M Hack
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitget Customers Withdraw Over 4,000 Bitcoins in One Hour Following $388M Hack Bitget this week resumed customer withdrawals and within one hour, users had taken over 4,000 bitcoins off the exchange. This post Bitget Customers Withdraw Over 4,000 Bitcoins in One Hour Following $388M Hack first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .
